level_meaning.3: 불필요한 여행 자제 권고(Reconsider Nonessential Travel)

high_severity_notices.headline: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Ituri and Nord-Kivu Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
high_severity_notices.description: CDC recommends avoiding all travel to Ituri and Nord-Kivu (North-Kivu) provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak unless traveling for humanitarian aid or emergency response.

high_severity_notices.headline: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Haut-Uélé and Tshopo Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
high_severity_notices.description: CDC recommends avoiding nonessential travel to Haut-Uélé and Tshopo provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak.

all_notices.headline: Global Dengue
all_notices.description: Dengue is a year-round risk in many parts of the world, with outbreaks commonly occurring every 2–5 years. Travelers to risk areas should prevent mosquito bites.  Country List :  Colombia, Vietnam, Maldives, Bolivia, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Costa Rica, Marshall Islands, Vanuatu Country List :  Colombia, Vietnam, Maldives, Bolivia, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Costa Rica, Marshall Islands, Vanuatu Country List :  Colombia, Vietnam, Maldives, Bolivia, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Costa Rica, Marshall Islands, Vanuatu, Cuba, Ecua Country List :  Colombia, Vietnam, Bolivia, Cambodia, Kenya, Malaysia, Bangladesh, Marshall Islands, Vanuatu, Cuba, Ecuador, including the Galápagos Islands, Panama, Chad, Peru

all_notices.headline: Yellow Fever in Burkina Faso, Côte d’Ivoire, and Ghana
all_notices.description: There are outbreaks of yellow fever in the Nando Region of Burkina Faso, Bounkani Region of Côte d’Ivoire, and the Upper West Region of Ghana. Travelers to these regions should take steps to prevent yellow fever by getting vaccinated at least 10 days before travel and taking steps to prevent mosquito bites. Country List :  Ghana, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast) Country List :  Ghana, Burkina Faso, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast)

all_notices.headline: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Kenya
all_notices.description: The Kenyan Ministry of Health has confirmed an imported case, as well as other linked cases, of Ebola disease caused by Bundibugyo virus in Nairobi, Kenya.

all_notices.headline: Yellow Fever in Colombia
all_notices.description: An increased number of cases of yellow fever have been reported in Colombia.

all_notices.headline: Global Polio
all_notices.description: Some international destinations have circulating poliovirus. Before any international travel, make sure you are up to date on your polio vaccines. Country List :  Afghanistan, Algeria, Benin, Cameroon, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire (Ivory Coast), Democratic Republic of the Congo, Niger, Nigeria, Pakistan, Somalia, Yemen, Sudan, Angola, Ethiopia, Republic of South Sudan, Djibouti, Germany, United Kingdom, including England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, Papua New Guinea, Central African Republic, Tanzania, including Zanzibar, Laos, Namibia, Mali, Malawi, Zambia, Togo, Israel, the West Bank and Gaza

all_notices.headline: Hepatitis A in Costa Rica
all_notices.description: There is an outbreak of hepatitis A (HAV) in Costa Rica. Most cases have been reported in San José province.

all_notices.headline: Chikungunya in Nicaragua
all_notices.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in Nicaragua. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

all_notices.headline: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda
all_notices.description: CDC recommends practicing enhanced precautions for travel to Uganda or to provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) not affected by the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak. Country List :  Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda Country List :  Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda Country List :  Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda

all_notices.headline: Paratyphoid Fever in Yemen
all_notices.description: Cases of paratyphoid fever are being reported in returning travelers from Yemen. You can prevent paratyphoid fever by practicing safe eating and drinking habits.

all_notices.headline: Diphtheria in Sub-Saharan Africa
all_notices.description: There are outbreaks of diphtheria in several countries in Africa. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease.  Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia, Senegal Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia, Senegal Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia, Senega Country List :  Chad, Guinea, Niger, Nigeria, Mali, Mauritania, Somalia, Senegal

all_notices.headline: Zika in Indonesia
all_notices.description: Cases of Zika are being reported in returning travelers from Bali, Indonesia. All travelers to Bali should take steps to prevent mosquito bites and sexual transmission of Zika virus during and after travel.

all_notices.headline: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Ituri and Nord-Kivu Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
all_notices.description: CDC recommends avoiding all travel to Ituri and Nord-Kivu (North-Kivu) provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak unless traveling for humanitarian aid or emergency response.

all_notices.headline: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Haut-Uélé and Tshopo Provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo
all_notices.description: CDC recommends avoiding nonessential travel to Haut-Uélé and Tshopo provinces in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) due to the current Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak.

all_notices.headline: Chikungunya in Costa Rica
all_notices.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in northwest Costa Rica. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

all_notices.headline: Diphtheria in Haiti
all_notices.description: There is an outbreak of diphtheria in Haiti. Vaccination against diphtheria is essential to protect against the disease.

all_notices.headline: Malaria in Yemen
all_notices.description: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Yemen, including in areas that were previously considered low-risk.

all_notices.headline: Hepatitis A in Canada
all_notices.description: Manitoba, Canada is currently experiencing a hepatitis A virus (HAV) outbreak. HAV is contagious and spreads through close person-to-person contact and by eating contaminated food or drink.

all_notices.headline: Chikungunya in French Guiana
all_notices.description: There is an outbreak of chikungunya in French Guiana. You can protect yourself by preventing mosquito bites.

all_notices.headline: Malaria in Mayotte
all_notices.description: Increased cases of malaria have been reported in Mayotte. Malaria is spread by the bite of infected mosquitoes.

all_notices.headline: Meningococcal Disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
all_notices.description: There is an outbreak of meningococcal disease in the Mangembo Health Zone of Kongo Central Province. The best way to protect yourself is to get meningococcal vaccination.

all_notices.headline: Rocky Mountain Spotted Fever in Mexico
all_notices.description: Illness and death due to Rocky Mountain spotted fever (RMSF) have been reported in the northern region of Mexico along the U.S. border, particularly in Baja California, Sonora, Chihuahua, Coahuila, and Nuevo León.

all_notices.headline: Global Measles
all_notices.description: Measles cases are rising in many countries around the world. All international travelers should be fully vaccinated against measles with the measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine, according to CDC's measles vaccination recommendations for international travel.
